scripts.prepare:model: node scripts/download-ner.mjs && node scripts/download-ocr.mjs && node scripts/download-speech.mjs

scripts.verify:model: node scripts/verify-ner.mjs && node scripts/download-ocr.mjs --verify && node scripts/download-speech.mjs --verify
